Stop.command: sh -c 'd=$(pwd); while [ ! -f "$d/check" ] || [ ! -d "$d/tools/check" ]; do [ "$d" = / ] && exit 0; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; exec sh "$d/check" --hook antigravity'

hooks.command: sh -c 'd=$(pwd); while [ ! -f "$d/check" ] || [ ! -d "$d/tools/check" ]; do [ "$d" = / ] && exit 0; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; exec sh "$d/check" --guard antigravity'
